title: Migrate callable query-root and structural materialization consumers
goal: Update a parameter query-root consumer while retaining working structural materialization and identifying already unavailable entity-only hooks.

selectionNotes: EF10 already error-obsoletes IEntityMaterializerSource and EntityMaterializerSourceParameters. CollectionResultExpression.Navigation and ProjectionBindingExpression are also already error-obsolete: use StructuralProperty and QueryExpression on both versions. There is no valid EF10 entity-only comparison to revive. Pingu approved the callable parameter-root comparison on 5 November 2026. The older ParameterExpression constructor and property are warning-obsolete but callable; EF11 takes QueryParameterExpression. Structural materialization already exists in EF10. This bounded extension consumer obtains the public structural service and its entity materializer; real provider reads verify nested complex values and nullable scalar results. Root construction is a contract check; the subsequent collection query exercises the normal provider, not a custom query translator. No replacement provider, custom SQL translator or internal service implementation is taught.

packageAssets: Independent locked EF10.0.13/net10.0/SDK10.0.403/C#14 and EF11.0.0/net11.0/SDK11.0.100/C#15 graphs. EF11 requires .NET11; no older-runtime EF11 route. Current proof uses RC2, not GA. No experimental attribute or opt-in is required on the exercised public contracts.
